description: Every SAT/CEGAR instance of the exact base (Erdos #883(i), n <= 79). One instance per (n,b,l') with l' in [first uncovered l, m] for each probe-6 residual (n,b).
note: 99 = 93 runs of exact883 + 6 of exact883b (c <= cmax; c > cmax certified by Family M per c, rechecked in coverage_ledger.py). The earlier '92' in gap_reflection_883_cycle3.json was a miscount; no instance is redundant.
certificate_pipeline: exact_log.py re-runs the CEGAR (CaDiCaL 1.5.3, seed 0) and logs every blocking clause with a canonical witness cycle; sat_cert.py (independent of exact883/exact883b) checks every witness cycle, rebuilds the base CNF with its own encodings, solves base+blocks with Glucose 4 (proof logging), checks the DRUP proof with drat-trim (commit 2e3b2dc0) and converts it to LRAT, checked again with lrat-check.
